messages:
alex: starting a canary for vanguard-v2q (int4) on canary-03. quick heads-up: we9re seeing ~6% funcall JSON parse failures vs ~0.5% on fp16 mirror. likely quantization/tokenization delta.
infra-bot: canary deploy vanguard-v2q -> route: canary-03 (deployed by @deploybot)
priya: pasted one raw snippet we logged (truncated):
```
MODEL OUT:
"{"action": "createIssue", "args": {"title": "Crash on save", "body": "Repro steps:\n1) open app\n2) save\u0007"}}..."
```
alex: that contains a BEL () control char and truncated suffix. looks like streaming cut mid-codepoint or tokenizer shift.
sam: are these correlated with batching or kvprefix? int4 tokenization shifts can change chunk boundaries and lead to mid-utf8 breaks. we should capture tokenization_delta per run.
luca: i'll mirror a kvprefix-off slice of the same traffic for 30m and upload outputs.
nora: proposal for canary-only parser-repair flow (opt-in): on parse failure try in order: 1) regex-extract first balanced `{...}` block, 2) strip non-printable/control chars (map BEL/NUL to space), 3) close unmatched braces and remove trailing commas, 4) try NDJSON parse if multiple newline objects, emit parse_repair=true telemetry.
priya: concrete action plan: 1) kvprefix-off mirror (luca, today), 2) land parser-repair shim behind flag + unit/e2e tests (sam, today), 3) fallback policy to fp16 after 1 retry for user-critical funcalls (nora, tomorrow). prio: minimize user-visible failures.
alex: sample route config we can roll to canary: 
```
{
  "route": "canary-03",
  "on_parse_fail": [
    {"action": "retry_with_repair", "max_retries": 1},
    {"action": "fallback_model", "model": "vanguard-v2"}
  ]
}
```
sam: keep max_retries=1 to avoid tail latency amplification. also log tokenization_delta, kvprefix_flag, and repair_action for each attempt.
luca: uploading sample dump to s3://redwood-canary/vanguard-v2q/2026-03-21/parse-fail-samples.json (contains raw outputs + meta).
priya: repair adds ~10-15ms median when invoked (local test). fine for canary; must validate against SLA before prod rollout.
nora: additional heuristic: if chunks look like multiple JSON objects separated by newlines, try NDJSON pick-first strategy. helps streaming-boundary cases.
alex: recap action items: @luca run kvprefix-off mirror + upload; @sam PR parser-repair shim + tests; @nora add fallback policy + NDJSON attempt; @priya add dashboard panels for parse_success_rate, parse_repair_rate by model_variant and kvprefix flag. 3PM PT check-in to review.
priya: adding dashboard panel now.
alex: if repair fixes >80% of int4 failures and kvprefix toggle reduces tokenization_delta we can plan controlled rollout; otherwise revert canary to fp16. :thumbsup:
